figurative_meaning_en: a brief viewing or fleeting glimpse
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি শুধু ঝাঁকি দর্শন করে চলে গেলেন।
আমরা দূর থেকে ঝাঁকি দর্শন পেলাম মন্দিরের।
example_sentences_in_english: He only caught a glimpse and left.
We got a brief view of the temple from afar.
history: Refers to the tradition of Jhanki Darshan during the Rath Yatra of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, where devotees get a brief glimpse of the deities.
note: Deeply tied to Hindu pilgrimage practices in Bengal and Odisha.
